prompt_text:
subject_definitions:
<Subject 1> is the young man in <Picture 1>: a Chinese man about 26 years old with a lean but healthy build, natural short black hair, a clean-shaven face, straight dark eyebrows and fresh, ordinary, approachable features, wearing a plain gray crew-neck T-shirt under an unbuttoned dark blue-gray casual overshirt, black straight-leg trousers and white sneakers. Here he also wears white wireless earbuds and a simple black commuting backpack.

summary:
[reference generation] In a crowded morning subway carriage, the camera drifts past other commuters and finds <Subject 1> standing by the doors while his inner voice speaks.

retention_analysis:
<Subject 1> (appears in [Shot 1]): fully_preserved - his face, short black hair, eyebrows, lean build, gray T-shirt and dark blue-gray overshirt are retained, with earbuds and backpack added.

detailed_description:
The target video is a photorealistic premium television commercial filmed with a cinematic 35 mm lens, shallow depth of field, natural skin texture, soft highlight roll-off, restrained contrast and cool blue-gray tones.
[Shot 1] A medium-wide shot inside a realistic Chinese subway carriage during the morning rush hour. Adult office workers stand in an orderly, slightly crowded space under cool overhead light; two coworkers chat quietly near the middle, and two friends look at one phone together and smile. The camera trucks right with small amplitude at slow speed past the softly blurred shoulders of foreground passengers and settles on <Subject 1>, who stands beside the doors with one hand resting on a vertical steel pole, white earbuds in his ears and his black backpack on his shoulders. He is framed from the waist up, his face clearly visible in three-quarter view, calm and thoughtful, looking toward his reflection in the dark door window. City tunnel lights streak past outside the glass. <Subject 1> (S1), in a clean, natural, slightly low-pitched male voice of a man in his late twenties, relaxed and reflective, says in an off-screen voiceover: <d>[English] It's not that I don't want to meet people.</d> while his lips remain completely closed. His expression stays calm. There is no text anywhere in the frame.

overall_soundscape: A low steady subway rumble, very faint indistinct station announcements and soft, indistinct passenger conversation.

non_diegetic_music: Spacious ambient electronic music: soft sustained synth pads at a slow tempo with no beat, low in volume.
